{"command": "cat > tests/test_handler.py <<EOF
from app.api.handlers import handle_filter_users

def test_filter():
    params = {"where": "id > 0"}
    status, result = handle_filter_users(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 2
    
    params = {"where": "name == 'Ada'"}
    status, result = handle_filter_users(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada"

    params = {"where": "id > 1 and email != 'x@y.org'"}
    status, result = handle_filter_users(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["id"] == 2
    
    params = {"where": "invalid"}
    status, result = handle_filter_users(params)
    assert status == 400

    params = {"where": "id + 1 == 2"}
    status, result = handle_filter_users(params)
    assert status == 400

test_filter()
EOF
python3 tests/test_handler.py
"}
